dedup.scope: The public identity index, the retired-claims record and the current worklist were searched with the object names of this claim (Witt sheaf, unramified Witt sheaf, Witt groups with support, Gersten-Witt spectral sequence, characteristic-zero fibre, inverting 2); the one public item taken from this same source is compared directly, and only the independent statement named in the counted unit is counted.

compared.difference: Same source, different proposition: the counted public unit of doi:10.5802/jep.153 is Theorem 3.6 clause 2 (source lines 755-765 with proof 766-771), absolute purity of the minus and rational motivic sphere spectra for smoothable morphisms between regular schemes. Its own editorial boundary says that the category-of-Witt-motives identification and the separate formal corollaries are context only. The present card counts Proposition 13.2 (source lines 2513-2519) with its own proof at 2520-2568, the comparison of the 2-inverted Witt sheaf of a Z[1/2]-scheme with the Witt sheaf of its characteristic-zero fibre; that comparison is an appendix result about Witt groups with support and is neither a corollary nor a premise of the counted absolute-purity theorem.
